title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Overhaul
items.text: Brian Rolapp's 2028 plan splits PGA Tour into top-tier and lower-tier events, angering players who fear stars like Scottie Scheffler and Jordan Spieth might be barred from hometown tournaments if events overlap.

items.headline: DeChambeau Investigates Swing Issue
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau shot 65-68 at LIV Golf Korea and trails the leader by one, admitting he’ll investigate why his swing 'went sideways' after shaky ball-striking despite solid putting.
